title: The Assurance of Things Hoped For

request.style: English, classic soul, rich warm female vocal with backing singers, Rhodes electric piano, Hammond organ, warm bass, tight drums, horn section stabs, slow groove, 82 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Before a single star was hung, before the hills were made
God spoke a word into the dark and all the worlds obeyed
The things we see were fashioned out of what no eye had seen
By faith we understand it, and on that word we lean

[Chorus]
Faith is the assurance of what we hope for
The conviction of what we do not see
Faith is the assurance of what we hope for
The conviction of what we do not see
It was by faith that the people of old received God's approval

[Verse]
Abel brought a better gift and God called him righteous
Though he is dead, his faith still speaks across the years to us
Enoch walked to please the Lord and never did see death
God took him up and he was not found, gone like a morning breath

[Chorus]
Faith is the assurance of what we hope for
The conviction of what we do not see
Faith is the assurance of what we hope for
The conviction of what we do not see

[Bridge]
Without faith it is impossible to please him
Whoever comes to God must believe that he exists
And that he rewards those who seek him

[Chorus]
Faith is the assurance of what we hope for
The conviction of what we do not see
Faith is the assurance of what we hope for
The conviction of what we do not see

[Outro]
What we do not see
What we do not see
